title: crypto2dev: AES-CBC and AES-GCM cipher callbacks
description: Implement CryptoCb handlers for AES-CBC and AES-GCM via the crypto2dev fd pool. For each operation: acquire OPERATION fd, SET_IV, write plaintext/ciphertext, FINALIZE, read output, release fd. AES-GCM additionally: SET_AAD before write, GET_TAG after read (encrypt) or SET_TAG before write (decrypt), check FINALIZE return for -EBADMSG (auth failure). Map wolfSSL WC_CIPHER_AES_CBC → algo string 'cbc(aes)', WC_CIPHER_AES_GCM → 'gcm(aes)'. Handle SETKEY callback (WOLF_CRYPTO_CB_SETKEY): store key material in a per-Aes context struct in aes->devCtx for later use by encrypt/decrypt callbacks.
notes: GCM auth tag failure must return AES_GCM_AUTH_E not a generic error. IV for CBC is in aes->reg. GCM IV is provided by the caller in the wc_AesGcmEncrypt() call. Inline key in INIT struct fits AES-128/192/256 (max 32 bytes, well within 128-byte limit).
